faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our escape games, tours and audio tours in Tenerife.
faq.q1: What does Fun Zone Tenerife offer?
faq.a1: Fun Zone Tenerife is your guide to the best things to do in Tenerife. We run our own self-guided outdoor escape games, resell self-guided city audio tours, and help you find and book the island's top tours and activities through our travel partners.
faq.q2: How do the outdoor escape games work?
faq.a2: You play on your own phone in a real Tenerife town, following GPS-triggered clues and solving puzzles tied to the place around you. There is no fixed time slot and no guide to meet: you start whenever you like, any day, and go at your own pace. After booking you receive an activation code by email.
faq.q3: What do I need to play an escape game?
faq.a3: One smartphone with mobile internet and enough battery per team, plus comfortable shoes and water, since the game is played walking outdoors. No special skills or experience are needed.
faq.q4: How many people can play, and what age?
faq.a4: You buy one activation code per phone (team), and large groups simply split into several teams that compete to finish first. We recommend ages 12 and up; younger children are welcome with an accompanying adult.
faq.q5: In which languages are the games and tours available?
faq.a5: Our outdoor escape games are available in several languages. The city audio tours are narrated in up to 32 languages, and the whole website is in English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch and Italian.
faq.q6: How do I book, and when do I get my code?
faq.a6: Book online and pay securely by card. For the escape games, your activation code is emailed to you right after payment, so you can start whenever suits you.
faq.q7: Can I cancel or get a refund?
faq.a7: Your escape-game activation code stays valid for a long period after purchase, so there is no fixed date to cancel around; for a specific case, just contact us. Tours and activities booked through our travel partners follow that partner's own cancellation policy, shown at checkout.
faq.q8: How do the tours and activities bookings work?
faq.a8: For the island's tours and activities, Fun Zone acts as a guide: you book directly with our trusted travel partners (such as GetYourGuide), who handle payment, your voucher and their own free-cancellation terms. Most offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
faq.q9: What are the city audio tours?
faq.a9: Self-guided GPS audio tours of Canary Islands towns (Tenerife, Gran Canaria, Lanzarote and Fuerteventura), narrated in your language and playable offline at your own pace. They cost 12 € per activation code.
faq.q10: Do you have activities for groups, stag and hen parties?
faq.a10: Yes. Our outdoor escape games are a favourite for groups, stag and hen weekends and team building: everyone splits into competing teams and plays at their own pace. We also list plenty of group-friendly boat trips and activities on our celebrations page.
faq.q11: When is the best time to visit Tenerife?
faq.a11: Tenerife is a genuine year-round destination, with daytime temperatures of roughly 18–28 °C. Spring and autumn offer warm, quieter and cheaper trips; summer is hottest and busiest; and whale watching runs 365 days a year.
faq.q12: What can I do in Tenerife when the weather is bad?
faq.a12: The south of the island sits in a rain shadow and usually stays dry even when the north is cloudy. If the weather does turn, our self-guided escape games, the city audio tours, Siam Park's covered areas and the island's museums all make great rainy-day options.

waiver.title: Safety Waiver
waiver.subtitle: Please read and accept the safety rules before your session
waiver.rule1: Axe throwing and shurikens: ages 14 and above. Archery: ages 8 and above. All minors under 18 must be accompanied by a responsible adult. Closed-toe shoes are required at all times. Consumption of alcohol before or during the activity is strictly prohibited.
waiver.rule2: Only designated participants are allowed in the throwing zones. Do not throw axes until everyone is behind the safety line. Wait for staff signal before retrieving axes or projectiles.
waiver.rule3: Always hold the axe by the handle, never by the head. No sudden movements with throwing equipment. Only use axes, shurikens, and knives provided by Axe Throwing Tenerife.
waiver.rule4: Respect staff, other participants, and equipment at all times. Any form of violent, reckless, or irresponsible behavior will result in immediate expulsion without refund.
waiver.rule5: Report any injury immediately to staff. First aid kits are available on-site. Staff are trained in basic first aid procedures.
waiver.acceptText: I have read and understood the above safety rules. I acknowledge that axe throwing, shuriken throwing, and knife throwing are inherently dangerous activities. I voluntarily assume all risks and hereby release and discharge Axe Throwing Tenerife, its owners, employees, and agents from any and all liability, claims, demands, or causes of action arising from my participation in these activities, including but not limited to personal injury, property damage, or death, whether caused by negligence or otherwise.

escape.title: ESCAPE GAME
escape.subtitle: Tenerife Chronicle — outdoor escape adventures
escape.description: Forget everything you think you know about Tenerife. Behind the beaches and hotel pools, this island hides centuries of secrets that 99% of visitors will never discover. Our outdoor escape games transform you into real investigators: solve puzzles hidden in monuments, decode messages carved in stone, and explore alleys that even locals have forgotten. You'll laugh, you'll search, you'll learn incredible true stories — and you'll see Tenerife with completely new eyes. No screens. No walls. Just you, the streets, and mysteries that have been waiting for centuries.

ichasagua.title: The Code of Ichasagua
ichasagua.description: Explore the streets of Los Cristianos and uncover the ancient secret of the Guanche code. Decipher clues hidden in historical landmarks and solve puzzles that reveal a forgotten legend.

troisCles.title: The Chest of Three Keys
troisCles.description: Wander through the UNESCO World Heritage streets of La Laguna in search of three legendary keys. Each key unlocks a new chapter of an intrigue that has spanned centuries.

bateria.title: The Loot of La Batería
bateria.description: Follow the trail of a pirate treasure hidden along the coast of Puerto de la Cruz. Navigate through the historic harbour, decipher maritime codes and find the lost loot before time runs out.

cendres.title: The Ashes of the Soul
cendres.description: Delve into the volcanic history of Garachico, a town destroyed and reborn from lava. Uncover the mystery of a soul trapped between the ruins and the sea in this atmospheric adventure.
